hero.titleLine2: and Forge Our Path through Cooperation
hero.subtitle: In every studio, stage, and workshop across Gyeonggi-do, there are artists who shine with their own unique light. We join hands so that light may not flicker alone, so the creative journey may not grow weary.

mission.heading: Our Purpose
mission.p1: In an era when passion alone is not enough to keep the flame of creation alive, we stand before walls of creative solitude and uncertain realities. Amid these challenges, we reach out to artists who were once scattered, to become pillars of strength for one another. The Gyeonggi Art Collective Cooperative — a producer cooperative established voluntarily by artists based in Gyeonggi-do — is that first step of hope.
mission.p2: Our cooperative aims, through autonomous, self-reliant, and self-governing cooperative activities, to support artists in Gyeonggi-do, foster the sustainability of creative work, and contribute to the vitalization of the regional cultural arts ecosystem. To this end, we actively carry out education, training, and information-sharing activities for our members, committed to being a steadfast partner to artists.
mission.p3: We will also pursue diverse projects — music production and distribution, concert planning and management, arts education, and more — opening pathways for our members' creative work to be properly valued and reach audiences. This will lay the groundwork for sustainable artistic practice, empowering members toward economic independence so that their art becomes a source of vitality rather than a threat to their livelihood.
mission.p4: Our stage spans all of Gyeonggi-do. Through cultural arts education for local residents and students, and through close collaboration with other cooperatives and regional institutions, we aim to build a culture where art flows naturally into everyday life. We envision a cultural community where creators, planners, supporting members, and all who share our vision inspire one another and cheer each other's new challenges.
mission.p5: The Gyeonggi Art Collective Cooperative is a plaza where the dreams of individual artists come together to build a greater world. We invite your warm interest and participation in a journey toward a future where artists' rights are respected, the joy of creation abounds, and its fruits are shared with the community.

chairman.heading: A Message from the President
chairman.name: President Choi Hee-cheol
chairman.quote1: To my fellow artists. Hello, I am Choi Hee-cheol, President of the Gyeonggi Art Collective Cooperative. I understand, perhaps more than anyone, the sense of helplessness that comes with the word 'alone.' I believe our coming together will carve a warm path through that helplessness.
chairman.quote2: Here, not only your successes but also your failures and struggles become precious assets. Please don't hesitate to share your voice. We are always ready to listen.

connect.joinSubtitle: We want to be with artists, planners, and all who share our purpose and are based in Gyeonggi-do.
connect.qual1Body: Artists of all disciplines who live or work in Gyeonggi-do
connect.qual2Body: Professionals engaged in cultural arts planning, production, or management
connect.qual3Body: Anyone who agrees with our mission and wishes to contribute to the development of the arts ecosystem
connect.qualFooter: We welcome artists, planners, and all who love the arts.
connect.commit1Body: A minimum investment of 1 share (₩10,000) is required to become a member. Your share becomes the cooperative's capital and is refunded upon withdrawal per our articles of incorporation.
connect.commit2Body: A monthly membership fee of ₩10,000 is required to support cooperative operations. (Subject to adjustment by board resolution)
connect.commitFooter: We build a sustainable community that grows together through active member participation — a process of mutual cooperation through which each member's talents and values are fully expressed.
connect.supportBody: Even without becoming a member, you can contribute to the growth of Gyeonggi's arts ecosystem through sponsorship. Your interest and support means the world to our artists.
